suggestions: I'm grateful for a deploy that went green on the first try, no 2am rollback drama.
I'm thankful for the quiet ten minutes before Fajr when the whole street is still asleep.
I'm grateful for a code review comment that caught an off-by-one before it hit prod.
I'm thankful for teh tarik from the mamak downstairs, still hot enough to burn my tongue.
I'm grateful for a Jira ticket that turned out way simpler than the title made it sound.
I'm thankful for my mum texting to ask if I've eaten, every single day without fail.
I'm grateful for finding the one Stack Overflow answer that actually matches my stack trace.
I'm thankful for the smell of rain hitting hot asphalt right as I step out of the office.
I'm grateful for a CI pipeline that finally stopped flaking after I found the race condition.
I'm thankful for payday rezeki lining up right when the car needed new tyres.
I'm grateful for a manager who just said 'good work' and let me get back to it.
I'm thankful for an aunty at the nasi lemak stall who always gives a little extra sambal.
I'm grateful for a bug that only took an hour to find instead of the whole afternoon I'd braced for.
I'm thankful for old university friends still replying in the group chat after all these years.
I'm grateful for a weekend with nothing on the calendar and no laptop guilt either.
